Hello ladies,

We're meeting Tuesday the 17th at 7:00 at my house for The Lighthouse Keeper's Daughter. I'll make the lemon bars, someone please bring decaf because I'm out.

Margaret, you said you'd do the discussion questions this time, thank you! And could you let me know by Monday the 16th whether you can host in December? My daughter is coming for two weeks and I won't have the room.

Joan, could you confirm the library meeting room for January by Friday? I think you have the card for it.

See you soon,
Dolores

messages.text:
Hola a todas:

Nos reunimos el martes 17 a las 19:00 en mi casa para comentar La hija del farero. Yo hago las barritas de limón; que alguien traiga descafeinado, por favor, que se me acabó.

Margarita, dijiste que esta vez preparabas las preguntas, ¡gracias! ¿Y me avisas antes del lunes 16 si puedes ser la anfitriona en diciembre? Viene mi hija dos semanas y no tendré espacio.

Juana, ¿puedes confirmar la sala de la biblioteca para enero antes del viernes? Creo que tú tienes la tarjeta.

Nos vemos pronto,
Dolores

Spring 2027 registration is now open for graduate students. Your enrollment window closes Wednesday, December 9 at 11:59 PM. Doctoral students must register for at least 9 credits (or 1 credit of BIO 999 if advanced to candidacy) to keep full-time status and funding.

Register in HalvorsenOne > Student Center.
